title: feat(task_instances): Add operator_name_pattern pool_pattern queue_pattern as search filter
body:
## Related issues

Related: #53051

## WHY

according to discussion in PR #56920 
implement the search / pattern match counterpart filers in the backend for `pool`, `queue`, `operator`
